_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Q'umir p'ukllaqmi kanki {player_id} LinesOfAction p'ukllapi.
Q'umir p'ukllaykunaykiqa '{side}', huk p'ukllaqpa p'ukllaykunataq '{other}'.
Ll'ukuy formatu: `[b1b3]` (qallariy coordinata puriri coordinata). Ll'ukuyqa tiksi, saywa, icha ch'aska k'iti kanayuq k'itikunap maywiy kuti. Q'umir p'ukllaykunallatam ll'uk'iy atinki, ichataq huk p'ukllaqpa p'ukllaykunataq manam atinki; huk p'ukllaqpa p'ukllaykunata ch'askaykumuwanki.  Lliw q'umir p'ukllaykunayki 8-vecino q'aytu kaspa atawanki.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Chayqa, cheqanpi chayri diagonalman jina kanan tiyan.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Chay tʼaqa, maypichus kʼachata purinan tiyan.
